profile.legalName: Mountain Valley Child & Family Services, Inc.
profile.summary: A California nonprofit, operating since 1968, that provides residential treatment programs, mental health services and therapeutic behavioral services for youth ages 12 to 18. It also runs accredited Non-Public Special Education Schools for students in grades 5 to 12.

review.notes: The cited pages show Mountain Valley Child & Family Services, Inc. in Nevada City, CA runs a CDE-certified Non-Public Special Education School (grades 5-12), matching the agenda's Nevada City location and the nonpublic school special education master contract.
